hack.root_cause: Bancor Power Function Misuse (Weighted AMM Invariant Bypass)
hack.description: Value DeFi lost $11M — its third hack in six months — because its weighted AMM used a Bancor power function with an undocumented precondition that the swap logic never enforced, letting attackers bypass the invariant entirely on any non-50/50 pool.
